rationale: C16 supplies a concrete, material template for the child's operative clause: both direct appropriate government officials to arrange for flag display on all public buildings on the designated day, then urge the public to fly the flag at homes or other suitable places. C15 and C10 contain closely related flag-display formulas, but C16 has the strongest literal and structural correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby direct the appropriate officials of the Government to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all public buildings on Mother's Day, May 13, 1951
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby call upon the appropriate officials of the Federal Government, and of the State and local Governments, to arrange for the display of the flag of our Republic on all public buildings on Flag Day, June 14, 1950
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive administrative instruction is retained, with the occasion, date, and scope of officials adapted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: and I call upon the people to display the flag on that day at their homes or other suitable places
shared_material.parent_excerpt: and I urge the people of our Nation to observe that day ... by flying the flag at their homes or other suitable places
shared_material.explanation: Both follow the official-building directive with a public appeal using the nearly identical phrase 'at their homes or other suitable places.'
